name: rails-api
description: Ruby on Rails API-only preset — 37signals-style Rails conventions, RSpec testing, safe Postgres migrations, security, jobs, and webhooks.
license: MIT AND O'Saasy (Fizzy code examples in 37signals-skills skills)

external_setup.name: mgrep
external_setup.notes: Semantic code search plugin. settings_patch registers the Mixedbread-Grep marketplace and auto-enables the plugin.

external_setup.name: postgres-mcp
external_setup.install_hint: claude mcp add postgres --env DATABASE_URI=postgresql://<readonly_user>:<pass>@localhost:5432/<db_development> -- uvx postgres-mcp --access-mode=restricted
external_setup.notes: Not enabled by default — needs DATABASE_URI. Use a read-only role against the development DB; keep --access-mode=restricted. Gives EXPLAIN analysis, index tuning, health checks.

external_setup.name: playwright-mcp
external_setup.notes: Not enabled by default — low value for API-only apps. Enable only if the project serves admin/HTML pages or you need browser-based acceptance checks.
